UI_MinidoracatAutoDrive_ShowTrajectory_t: Shows the future driving line only while autodrive is engaged. Blue is the normal path and yellow is an obstacle-avoidance path. Disabling it does not affect autodrive.
UI_MinidoracatAutoDrive_TrajectoryWidth_: Adjusts the single autodrive trajectory line. Thin, standard, and thick use 1, 3, and 7 pixels. Each segment is still drawn once; this adds only a small amount of client pixel fill and does not affect the server.

UI_MinidoracatAutoDrive_AutoDetour_toolt: Off by default. When on, navigation is asked for an alternative route once per blockage as soon as the vehicle is blocked at the same spot again after one back-up rescan, or after 10 s of holding with no gap; if none exists, control is handed back after 15 s as usual. The HUD Reroute button always works regardless of this option; the HUD Auto-reroute pill mirrors this option.
UI_MinidoracatAutoDrive_ExportTelemetry_: Off by default. When enabled, this client writes AutoDrive diagnostic logs to this computer only: 64 fixed slots, up to 2 MiB each; takes effect on the next AutoDrive session. Starting a new log clears expired slots for reuse but keeps their filenames; a full slot stops appending for that drive and never overwrites its beginning. When reporting a navigation problem, zip the whole log folder and attach it. Logs contain in-game absolute coordinates (x/y), raw Unix epoch milliseconds (no timezone conversion) and the list of enabled mods - attach at your own discretion.
UI_MinidoracatAutoDrive_TelemetryRetenti: How long to keep diagnostic logs on this computer: 1, 3, 7, 14, or 30 days (default 7). Starting a new log clears expired slots for reuse but keeps their filenames. Does not affect driving.
UI_MinidoracatAutoDrive_CopyLatestTeleme: Copies the absolute path of the latest diagnostic log file to the clipboard - handy for a quick look at one session. For a full report use "Copy log folder path" below and attach the whole folder as a zip. Success normally shows a top-right toast; an older framework or a toast failure falls back to an overhead notice.
UI_MinidoracatAutoDrive_CopyTelemetryFol: Copies the absolute path of the local diagnostic-log folder; paste it into File Explorer to open it. When reporting a navigation problem, zip the entire folder (64 log slots plus manifest.txt, latest.txt and session-index.txt) and attach it - the timestamps in session-index.txt and the per-session logs are what let us pinpoint the failing drive. Attach the zip only; do not paste this path, it contains your computer account name.
UI_MinidoracatAutoDrive_TelemetryCopied: Diagnostic log path copied to the clipboard
UI_MinidoracatAutoDrive_TelemetryCopyFai: Could not copy the diagnostic log path
UI_MinidoracatAutoDrive_TelemetrySlotsFu: None of the 64 diagnostic log slots could be cleared for reuse; this drive will not be recorded
UI_MinidoracatAutoDrive_TelemetryWriteFa: Diagnostic logging failed; recording has stopped for this drive
UI_MinidoracatAutoDrive_TelemetryFileFul: The diagnostic log reached its 2 MiB limit; this drive will not append more data
